technical.title: New quadtree attention model improves hierarchical perception for robotics and autonomous driving.
technical.summary: Researchers introduced Sibling-Selective Quadtree Attention to leverage axis-aligned structural priors in navigation data, enabling effective hierarchical feature modeling for drone and autonomous driving perception tasks.
technical.why: It offers an optimized way to process structured visual data for autonomous navigation pipelines.

technical.title: GOFish enables full field-of-view Gaussian Splatting and mesh extraction.
technical.summary: GOFish is a 3D Gaussian Splatting surface reconstruction method that trains directly on fisheye images beyond 180 degrees, allowing robots and autonomous vehicles to extract aligned collision meshes.
technical.why: It solves wide field-of-view 3D reconstruction challenges for autonomous systems simulation.

technical.title: SpaceAct benchmark evaluates 3D spatial and temporal reasoning via closed-loop action.
technical.summary: SpaceAct is an interactive benchmark introducing the Spatiotemporal Active-Probing Agent framework to test multimodal large language models on 3D geometry reconstruction, dynamic anticipation, and physical execution.
technical.why: It provides a robust way to measure active perception and physical reasoning capabilities in embodied AI systems.

technical.title: SaiVLA-JEPA evaluates future latent prediction in vision-language-action control.
technical.summary: SaiVLA-JEPA pairs a vision-language model with a diffusion transformer policy using frozen V-JEPA features and auxiliary prediction heads to improve closed-loop visual control.
technical.why: It demonstrates how joint-embedding predictive architectures enhance robotic policy learning.

technical.title: Unlocking any-order generation in pretrained autoregressive image models.
technical.summary: A new method bypasses the high compute costs typically required to train image models on mixed token orderings, allowing pretrained raster-scan autoregressive models to gain inpainting and editing capabilities.
technical.why: It improves the flexibility of image generators without requiring expensive training from scratch.

technical.title: EasyProver scales Lean theorem proving for real-world code verification.
technical.summary: Using recursive agents with isolated contexts and parallel tactic probing, EasyProver solves complex verification problems and competitive programming benchmarks without additional model training.
technical.why: It advances automated mathematical reasoning and code verification techniques.

technical.title: Deploy NVIDIA Nemotron models on Amazon EKS and SageMaker HyperPod.
technical.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL combines multimodal understanding with reasoning and tool use, and can be deployed on AWS infrastructure using NVIDIA Dynamo and vLLM.
technical.why: It highlights practical deployment patterns for large multimodal mixture-of-experts models.

technical.title: Evaluating deep learning architectures for automated vocal fold segmentation.
technical.summary: This study benchmarks UNet, UNet++, and hybrid architectures to understand how deep learning design and ImageNet pretraining impact automated segmentation in high-speed ex vivo phonation images.
technical.why: It informs optimal architecture choices for specialized medical computer vision tasks.

technical.title: Mistral Large 4 OSS 🧠, agent swarm behavior 🤖, Sam Altman interview 🍺f
Hermit open-source framework adapts AI agent harnesses through task feedback.
technical.summary: Infini-AI-Lab released Hermit, an Apache-2.0 framework that trains an external instruction, skill, and memory layer from feedback while keeping the core agent model and harness untouched.
technical.why: It provides a modular approach to improving agent capabilities without modifying base models.

business.title: Anthropic files S-1 to go public on Nasdaq
business.summary: Anthropic has filed its S-1 to go public on the Nasdaq, prompting analysts to examine the company's financial numbers and path to AGI.
business.why: An impending IPO offers rare financial transparency into a leading foundation model lab.

business.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT for $15.3 billion
business.summary: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal to bring artificial intelligence into the home security business.
business.why: It shows AI expansion into traditional consumer hardware and home security markets.

business.title: Re:Build and Kalshi lead large funding rounds
business.summary: Manufacturing startup Re:Build closed on $2.1 billion and predictions marketplace Kalshi picked up $1 billion in a week featuring large funding rounds.
business.why: It signals massive capital allocation into physical AI and forecasting startups.

business.title: Amazon CEO says AWS will be a $1T business
business.summary: Amazon wants to be the king of AI cloud computing and reach $1 trillion in revenue, but CEO says it must continue its capex spending spree to achieve it.
business.why: It underscores the immense capital expenditure required to scale AI cloud infrastructure.

business.title: US investigates Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
business.summary: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China was investigated as a potential Chinese spy.
business.why: Geopolitical tensions directly affect hardware supply chains and semiconductor distribution.

business.title: Amazon AWS posts 39% revenue growth with new deals
business.summary: Amazon's cloud division signed deals with Meta and OpenAI during the quarter, helping revenue exceed consensus expectations.
business.why: It highlights major enterprise AI customers driving cloud infrastructure revenue growth.

business.title: Google stock tumbles as AI search makes less money
business.summary: Google's negative cash flow balloons to -$9.06 billion and its stock price tumbles following Q3 earnings as it fixes AI search monetization with more ads.
business.why: It reveals the monetization challenges of transitioning core search traffic to AI models.

business.title: Amazon posts negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion
business.summary: Amazon's negative free cash flow ballooned during the third quarter, while earnings and revenue fell short of Wall Street expectations.
business.why: It highlights the heavy financial pressures surrounding massive infrastructure investments.

business.title: Intel stock drops as massive AI spending worries investors
business.summary: Intel stock heads for its worst day in more than 50 years, wiping $12 billion off the government's stake as investors grow nervous about tech giants' massive AI spending.
business.why: Market volatility directly impacts semiconductor supply chains and public sector investments.

business.title: Series B funding reaches $48 billion despite fewer deals
business.summary: Investors have poured around $48 billion into Series B financings this year, reaching the highest tally in years, though round counts are on track for a multiyear low.
business.why: It indicates a concentration of capital into fewer, larger early-stage deals.

models.title: Mistral AI Unveils Mistral Large 4 Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Model
models.summary: Mistral Large 4 is a 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 49 billion active parameters per token, natively fluent in over 160 languages with strong visual grounding.
models.why: It unifies instruction following, reasoning, coding, and agentic workflows while surpassing closed frontier models on visual grounding.

models.title: Baidu Releases Unlimited OCR 2 for Long-Horizon Document Parsing
models.summary: Unlimited OCR 2 achieves unlimited-horizon document parsing, accompanied by the release of MarathonDocBench for evaluating ultra-long document parsing capabilities.
models.why: It pushes document intelligence boundaries from long-horizon to unlimited-horizon parsing.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 Uncensored Quantized Formats Released for ComfyUI
models.summary: Quantized GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX formats of Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 are released for local image generation using original upstream base weights and companion files for ComfyUI.
models.why: It enables localized, optimized image generation workflows across multiple hardware environments.

models.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Released with Enhanced Reasoning and Reduced Execution Time
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update delivering improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing task execution time and output length.
models.why: It advances the performance-cost Pareto frontier for agent harnesses.

models.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B Launches as a Flagship Teacher Model for Lightweight Agents
models.summary: Nanbeige4.3-33B is designed as a flagship teacher model for the Nanbeige4.3 series, delivering state-of-the-art open model agentic performance in the ~30B parameter class for complex coding and professional cowork tasks.
models.why: It establishes a foundation for distilling advanced agentic capabilities into smaller models.

models.title: LiquidAI Introduces LFM3-1.7B Text Model for Local Agents
models.summary: LFM3-1.7B is a text model for local agents built on a tri-hybrid architecture. It features a 256K-token context window, fits on phones or laptops at 4-bit precision, and supports single-GPU fine-tuning.
models.why: It provides a compact edge solution for specialized local agent applications.
